claim: A recording should start where the sprite and figure models can fill (the title) and reach the game's states; code reached only by unrecorded paths is proven by unit tests, not by replay.

evidence.text: A recording that starts mid-game leaves the sprite model and the figure model empty while the screen has figures; start every recording at the title, cheats poked into the start state.
evidence.quote: while the screen has figures; start every recording at the title, cheats poked into the start state.

evidence.text: The RZX covers levels 1-2 only; lifts are not touched by the patch and the free duck runs the same plotter call (41361) as the caged duck, covered by unit tests.
evidence.quote: the same plotter call (41361) as the caged duck, covered by unit tests.

evidence.text: Banks 3, 4 and 6 never paged in either RZX (probably later islands); a recording past island 1 is needed.
